chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
that he disliked that one should pray while wearing a garment in which are images.

key_terms.كَرِهَ: disliked (expressing a recommendation against, not prohibition)

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to pray in clothes with pictures?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) disliked praying while wearing a garment featuring images (tamasheel), a ruling rooted in the broader Shia jurisprudence regarding the purity of the worshipper's attire. This preference aligns with the principle of avoiding elements associated with idolatry or distraction during the sacred act of Salat, reflecting the meticulous attention to detail in the conditions of prayer.
